title: UTCS MCP Tool Definitions
description: MCP (Model Context Protocol) binding for UTCS. Each UTCS capability maps to one or more MCP tools. Tool names use the prefix declared in the provider's manifest (default: utcs_). Tool input schemas match UTCS request structures; tool output schemas match UTCS response structures.

tools.name: utcs_determine_tax
tools.description: Calculate US sales and use tax for a checkout transaction, B2C and B2B alike. Given items, addresses, entity type, and transaction type, returns applicable taxes with full jurisdiction breakdown and provider attestation. When commit=true, the provider records the transaction as final; when commit=false, the result is an estimate. This is the foundational UTCS capability — every other capability supports or extends tax determination. Returns structured UTCS error codes with recovery hints if tax cannot be accurately determined; never returns approximate values.

document_code.description: The caller's key for this transaction when the caller sends one. Optional. A caller SHOULD send it when commit is true: UTCS-6001 rejects a repeated commit of that code, and without it a retry is a new document. When omitted, the provider MAY generate a document_code. The result always returns one: the caller's value if sent, otherwise the generated value.

company_code.description: Identifier of the selling entity the transaction belongs to. Routes to the correct registered entity (nexus, registration, reporting).

transaction_date.description: ISO 8601 datetime of the transaction. Determines applicable tax rates and rules.

currency_code.description: ISO 4217 currency code (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP)

commit.description: true = commit (the provider records the transaction as final); false = estimate only

customer.description: Customer details including identifiers and exemption credentials

exemption_certificate_id.description: Exemption certificate on file. The provider MUST apply it or reject the request with UTCS-5001, UTCS-5002, UTCS-5003, or UTCS-5004. It MUST NOT be ignored. A prior successful validation does not apply it.

entity_use_code.description: Entity/use-based exemption reason (buyer exempt by status or use), independent of a certificate.

addresses.description: Transaction addresses. Provide ship_from + ship_to, or single_location for point-of-sale. Every address must include either a full street address (line1, city, postal_code, country) or geocoordinates (latitude, longitude, country). A postal code alone is never sufficient.

bill_to.description: Customer's billing address. Used where sourcing looks at bill-to, including California SB 122 (effective 1 January 2027), which sources SaaS and prewritten software by billing address first. Does not satisfy ship_to. A caller with only a billing address sends that same address as both bill_to and ship_to.

lines.description: Line items. At least one required. All monetary amounts are decimal strings.

discount.description: Transaction-level discount amount (decimal string), allocated across lines flagged discounted

marketplace.description: Marketplace facilitator context. Present when a facilitator may be liable to collect and remit tax.

reference_code.description: Optional reference to a related document or external system. When document_type is return and this is the original transaction's document_code, the provider MUST reverse the original tax for the returned portion and MUST NOT recalculate it at current rates. If that document cannot be found, the provider returns UTCS-6002. On any other document type this is an audit cross-reference and does not change the calculation.

purchase_order_number.description: Buyer's purchase order number. Optional; does not affect tax determination.

tax_override.description: Override for returns, imported amounts, or accrual scenarios

location_code.description: Seller outlet code for local reporting at this address. It does not change the address used to source the tax. When several addresses carry one, the seller origin governs: line ship_from, else transaction ship_from, else single_location. A code on ship_to or bill_to does not select the outlet.

quantity.description: MUST be non-zero. Negative only when document_type is return, and then amount MUST be negative too. A positive quantity on a return counts the units returned.

amount.description: Decimal string (e.g., "49.99"). On a return this is the signed tax base and MUST be negative.

discounted.description: If true, the transaction-level discount is allocated to this line.

entity_use_code.description: Per-line entity/use-based exemption reason, overriding the customer-level value.

exemption_certificate_id.description: Per-line exemption certificate identifier, overriding the customer-level value for this line. Applied, or the request fails with UTCS-5xxx. Never ignored. Validation alone does not apply it.

addresses.description: Per-line address override for split-origin or drop-ship fulfillment.

tax_override.description: Per-line override of the tax calculation for this line only.

tools.name: utcs_resolve_jurisdictions
tools.description: Resolve the applicable taxing jurisdictions for a given address or coordinate pair. Returns the full jurisdiction hierarchy (country, state/province, county, city, special taxing districts) with jurisdiction codes, names, and applicable tax types. Can operate independently for address validation and jurisdiction lookup scenarios.

tools.name: utcs_classify_product
tools.description: Map product identifiers (SKU, UPC, item codes) or natural-language descriptions to standardized tax codes. Critical for agentic commerce where AI agents describe products conversationally. Supports both code-based lookups and natural-language classification with confidence scores.

products.description: Products to classify. Provide description, item_code, or both.

jurisdiction.description: Target jurisdiction (tax codes may vary by jurisdiction)

tools.name: utcs_validate_exemption
tools.description: Validate exemption certificates, resale certificates, and other tax-exempt credentials in real-time. Supports programmatic exchange of exemption credentials for B2B and agent-to-agent transactions without human intervention. Returns validity status, exemption type, expiration, and covered jurisdictions. A successful validation exempts nothing. Exemption takes effect only when a determination applies the certificate, and a certificate that cannot be applied fails that determination with UTCS-5xxx.

certificate_id.description: Exemption certificate identifier on file with the provider

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction to validate the exemption against

product_tax_code.description: Tax code to check exemption applicability for

transaction_date.description: ISO 8601 date to check validity against

tools.name: utcs_get_document
tools.description: Retrieve an audit-defensible compliance document for a committed transaction. Returns the full compliance record including the original tax result, audit trail, and document status.

document_id.description: Identifier of a compliance document. Exists only once the compliance-documents capability has produced one. Not a Tax Result field, and not a synonym for document_code or result_id.

tools.name: utcs_calculate_duties
tools.description: Experimental. Not part of envelope 1.0 conformance. Calculate cross-border duties and tariffs for international transactions. Handles customs duty calculation, landed cost estimation, VAT/GST determination, de minimis threshold awareness, country-of-origin rules, HS classification, Incoterms (DAP, DDP, FOB, FCA, EXW, etc.), and importer of record designation.

hs_code.description: Harmonized System tariff code (REQUIRED for cross-border)

trade_agreements.description: Applicable trade agreements (e.g., USMCA, EU-UK TCA)

tools.name: utcs_check_obligations
tools.description: Experimental. Not part of envelope 1.0 conformance. Check filing obligations across jurisdictions. Returns nexus accumulation status, economic nexus threshold monitoring, and filing requirement awareness. Helps merchants understand where they are accumulating obligations and what filing requirements are being created as agents transact across jurisdictions.

start_date.description: Start of the reporting period (ISO 8601 date)

end_date.description: End of the reporting period (ISO 8601 date)
